title: Metric Decomposition and Factor Tree Analysis
description: Mathematical deconstruction of aggregate metric movements into constituent multiplicative and additive drivers.
conditions: Top-line KPI exhibits significant unexpected increase or decrease (e.g. Revenue fell by 15%)
Need to isolate exact mathematical drivers rather than relying on correlation guesses
recommended_methods: Multiplicative DuPont equation deconstruction (e.g. Revenue = Active Users * Conversion Rate * AOV)
selection_rules: Deconstruct top-line metric into its fundamental equation tree before exploring demographic segments
Calculate percentage contribution of each driver: Delta_Driver / Total_Delta
Prioritize deep-dive investigation on the driver accounting for > 60% of the net variance
limitations: Decomposition reveals which mathematical component shifted, not the external real-world cause
Simultaneous shifts in multiple correlated drivers create interaction terms that require allocation rules
